type.name: The Reformer
type.coreDesire: To be good, virtuous, and have integrity
type.coreWeakness: Resentment—repressed anger from feeling that things are never good enough
type.description: Principled, purposeful, self-controlled, and perfectionistic. Ones have a strong sense of right and wrong and advocate for change. They fear being morally flawed and strive for integrity in all they do.
keyMotivations: Striving to be right and to improve everything
Justifying position and maintaining high standards
averageTraits: Highly critical of self and others

integration.name: The Enthusiast
integration.description: Ones access joy and spontaneity of healthy Sevens

disintegration.name: The Individualist
disintegration.description: Ones become moody and irrational like unhealthy Fours

witness_prompts.prompt: Where do you notice the pattern of being corrupt, evil, or defective arising in your life?
Can you observe the improving pattern without trying to change it?
What does this pattern protect you from?
